name: Square One Mall
summary: Square One Mall is a family-oriented regional shopping center in Saugus, Massachusetts, featuring brand-name retailers, a food court, and family amenities including kids' play areas and a nursing lounge. Managed by Simon Property Group since 1994, this traditional enclosed mall serves the North Shore community with convenient shopping and dining options.
demographics: Square One Mall attracts a diverse middle-income demographic from the North Shore region of Massachusetts, including families from Saugus, Lynn, Revere, and surrounding communities. The primary visitor base consists of value-conscious shoppers aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, including a significant proportion of young families and working-class households. The trade area serves a densely populated suburban market with strong representation from both established residents and newer immigrant communities, creating a multicultural shopping environment that values practical retail options and family-friendly amenities.
description: Square One Mall has served the North Shore community of Massachusetts since 1994, establishing itself as a reliable shopping destination at 1201 Broadway in Saugus. This regional mall offers a traditional enclosed shopping experience with brand-name retailers that cater to the everyday needs of local families and shoppers from surrounding communities. The center features thoughtfully designed amenities including dedicated kids' play areas where children can enjoy supervised fun while parents shop, as well as a convenient food court offering diverse dining options for quick meals and family gatherings. A nursing lounge provides a comfortable, private space for mothers, demonstrating the mall's commitment to family-friendly services. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's premier retail real estate companies, Square One Mall maintains consistent operating hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, making it accessible for both weekday and weekend shopping trips. With a strong 4.1-star rating from nearly 6,000 Google reviews, the mall has earned the trust and loyalty of the North Shore community as a dependable retail hub.
